lede: The biggest thing to track this week is the Telluride Hospital District's work session on Monday, where CommonSpirit Health comes in to present on a potential partnership — the terms still aren't public, but with a Letter of Intent already in play, this is the kind of quiet meeting that can shape how healthcare works in this valley for a long time. Alongside that, the Housing Authority Subcommittee digs into real policy questions about subpar bedrooms in mitigation units, the county's Housing Code Update SSR hits its eighth session targeting Land Use Code barriers to workforce housing, and HARC takes a hard look at a possible demolition and rebuild of Rebekah Hall — the town-owned building where they meet.

notable.stake: CommonSpirit partnership terms could reshape local healthcare; no materials posted yet.
